description: Represents one node of the share tree.

attributes.name: name
description: Node name (symbolic name or user or project name in the leafs)

attributes.name: type
description: Kind of tree: STT_USER or STT_PROJECT.
All nodes in a tree have the same type.

attributes.name: id
description: Only for editing and save/restore. May be different each time.

attributes.name: shares
description: Configured shares for the node or subtree under a leaf node.

attributes.name: children
description: Configured childrens of this node. Same type, it is a recursive tree structure.

attributes.name: job_ref_count
description: Number of running and pending jobs referencing this node (only used in scheduler thread).

attributes.name: active_job_ref_count
description: Number of running jobs referencing this node (only used in scheduler thread).

attributes.name: project
description: Set to 1 if this node is a project (only used in scheduler thread).

attributes.name: proportion
description: Share proportion (only used in scheduler thread).

attributes.name: adjusted_proportion
description: Share adjusted proportion (only used in scheduler thread).

attributes.name: combined_usage
description: Combined usage (only used in scheduler thread).

attributes.name: pass2_seqno
description: Sequence number for pass 2 of share calculation (only used in scheduler thread).

attributes.name: sum_priority
description: Sum of job priorities (only used in scheduler thread).

attributes.name: actual_proportion
description: Long term actual proportion.

attributes.name: m_share
description: Dynamic long term targetted proportion.

attributes.name: last_actual_proportion
description: Short term actual proportion.

attributes.name: adjusted_current_proportion
description: Short term targetted proportion.

attributes.name: temp
description: Temporary Node used in scheduler only.

attributes.name: stt
description: Short term targeted proportion of node as compared to sibling nodes.
Calculated during scheduling of pending of pending jobs.

attributes.name: ostt
description: Overall short term targeted proportion of node as compared to all nodes.
Calculated during scheduling of pending of pending jobs.

attributes.name: ltt
description: Long term targeted proportion of node as compared to all nodes.
Calculated during scheduling of pending of pending jobs.

attributes.name: oltt
description: Overall long term targeted proportion of node as compared to all nodes.
Calculated during scheduling of pending of pending jobs.

attributes.name: shr
description: Hierarchical calculated share node.
Calculated during scheduling of pending of pending jobs.

attributes.name: sort
description: Value for sorting jobs attached to a node.
Calculated during scheduling of pending of pending jobs.

attributes.name: ref
description: Temporary index reference back into the array of pending jobs.
Used during scheduling of pending of pending jobs.

attributes.name: tickets
description: Temporary storage of pending tickets from higher level policies.
Used during scheduling of pending of pending jobs.

attributes.name: jobid
description: Job number of a temporary job node.
Used during scheduling of pending of pending jobs.

attributes.name: taskid
description: Array task number of a temporary job node.
Used during scheduling of pending of pending jobs.

attributes.name: usage_list
description: Node usage list.
Used during scheduling of pending of pending jobs.

attributes.name: version
description: Incremented on every change to the tree, and again by the timer thread when usage is recomputed. Lets a reader tell whether the tree it holds is still current.

attributes.name: joker
description: Placeholder which can be used for arbitrary data.
Its purpose is to be able to add new attributes without changing the spooling format.
It is a list of arbitrary type and it is spooled.
